header.userPrompt: plan and bump the scala binding from r185 to r186, notice that threejs javascript code tag versions are checkouted in "submodules" folder.

findings.title: Formatting-only hunks in files the r186 bump does not touch are still present

reason.text: Environmental. I already restored these files and hunks to d607426 twice, and both times `sbt Test/compile` passed with a clean diff. They keep coming back because `.orca/settings.properties` sets `format = sbt scalafmtAll`, and that gate runs across the whole repo after every fix round. It reformats these files, which were already out of format at d607426. Reverting them again would just be undone by the next format run. Two ways to end the loop: limit or turn off the format gate (for example, apply repo-wide formatting in a separate commit first), or accept the formatter output.

resultJson.title: Bump three.js Scala.js bindings from r185 to r186
resultJson.body:
Updates the `modules/three` facades to match three.js r186. I compared `submodules/three.js-r185` with `submodules/three.js-r186`, and the plan is in `docs/r186-migration-plan.md`.

- **Deprecation:** `PCFSoftShadowMap` is now `@deprecated` because r186 removed it and renderers fall back to `PCFShadowMap`. `ShadowSample` now uses `PCFShadowMap` instead of the raw value `2`.
- **New `TextureSource` facade:** this is the r186 name for `Source`. `Texture.source` now uses it.
- **`Object3D.dispose()` and `intersectsFrustum()`:** `dispose()` moved from `Light` to `Object3D` in r186. Because of that, the existing `dispose()` on helpers, `InstancedMesh`, `Lensflare`, `Reflector` and `Refractor` is now marked `override`.
- **Other new APIs:**
  - `WebGLRenderTarget`: `resolveColorBuffer` and the `storeMultisampled*Buffer` flags, on the class and in its options
  - `LightShadow.getCamera`
  - `MeshPhysicalMaterial.retroreflectivity`
  - `Plane.toJSON` and `Plane.fromJSON`
  - `TrackballControls.rollSpeed` and `multiTouchRoll`

Changes to node/TSL/WebGPU and animation internals are out of scope because those parts have no bindings.

Reviewer note: some hunks are formatting-only and are in files the bump doesn't otherwise change, such as `HTMLTexture`, `RaycasterIntersection`, `Euler` and a few example samples. They come from the `sbt scalafmtAll` format step in the new `.orca/settings.properties`, which reformats the whole repo. Those files were already unformatted on the base branch. Attempts to revert them were undone by the next format run, so they are kept here. The diff also adds a one-line `WebGLRendererParameters.scala` to a file that was empty before.
